title: Lower Bounds on Diameter-Preserving Spanning Subgraphs of the Hypercube
description: Unconditional Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization for Graham and Harary's hypercube diameter-preserving spanning subgraph problem: proves the universal lower bound 2^n + ceil((2^n - 2n)/(n - 1)) <= f(n) for all n >= 2, raises the asymptotic second-term coefficient to 3/2 on the scale 2^n/(n - 1), and certifies 39 <= f(5) <= 40, f(6) >= 76, f(7) >= 150, f(8) >= 294, and lower bounds for every dimension 17 <= n <= 32. Coverage by this package's Palomar comparison: of the companion paper's 14 main results, 5 are compared in Lean in full (36%; Theorems 1, 3, 9 and 11 and Proposition 13) and 1 in part (Proposition 12: its instances f(6) >= 76 and f(8) >= 294, not its general certificate bridge); 7 more (Corollary 2, Proposition 4, Lemma 5, Theorem 6 and Propositions 7, 8 and 10) are proved in this package's Lean library but not compared; Proposition 14 is by certificate only; Conjecture 15 is open and not counted. Companion write-up and prior-work search log (including Google Scholar sweep on 2026-11-22) are published at https://mathdiscoveries.org/results/hypercube-edge-bounds; no priority is claimed over unread sources (the full body of Bouabdallah-Delorme-Djelloul 1995 and Djelloul's 1993 thesis could not be accessed). Generated and checked by AI research agents built and directed by Tyler B. Hughes. No human mathematician has yet refereed the proof.
